title: KitKat Club Door Test
lead: Answer honestly about your outfit and attitude and get a fictional door verdict.

hard_fetish.title: A hard fetish night
hard_fetish.sub: Saturday-style. Full latex and leather energy expected.

mixed_club.title: A mixed club night
mixed_club.sub: Weeknight-style. Broad crowd, still a real dress code.

techno.title: A techno-leaning night
techno.sub: Music-first crowd. Attitude and know-how matter more than the outfit.

options.text: Full latex or leather, considered head to toe.
One strong piece, harness or vinyl, over dark basics.
All black, smart, nothing fetish.
Jeans and a going-out top.
Boots or heels built for the outfit.
Plain black boots, nothing special.
Clean sneakers.
Trainers you wore sightseeing all day.

questions.question: How long did you spend getting ready?

options.text: I planned this outfit for weeks.
Real thought went into tonight specifically.
I threw on my going-out clothes.
I'm still in what I wore on the plane.

questions.question: Where's your head at in the queue?

options.text: Calm, quiet, taking the night seriously.
A little nervous but present.
Loud with the group, phone out.
Filming the queue for a story.

questions.question: The door asks about your phone.

options.text: It's already in my bag, off.
I hand it over without being asked twice.
I ask if I can just keep it in my pocket.
I say I'll only use it for one quick photo.
Alone, or with one person who gets the night.
A small group, everyone dressed and serious.
A group of five, mixed effort.
A stag or hen party, still in matching shirts.
I checked the program and dressed for this specific night.
I know roughly what kind of night it is.
I know it's KitKat, that's it.
I thought every night here was the same.

questions.question: The door asks you something short and direct.

options.text: A short, honest, direct answer.
A little rehearsed, but genuine.
I overexplain and joke nervously.
I get defensive and argue back.

questions.question: Someone in the queue asks you to move over.

options.text: I move immediately, no fuss.
I ask politely, then move.
I hesitate, checking who's watching.
I ignore them and keep talking.

straight_in.title: Straight in.
straight_in.message: The fictional door barely pauses on you tonight. Outfit, effort and attitude all line up.
straight_in.fix: Keep doing exactly this. Commitment reads instantly at the door.

in_after_look.title: In, after a long look.
in_after_look.message: The fictional bouncer takes a second look, then waves you through.
in_after_look.fix: One more committed choice, outfit or attitude, would have made this an easy yes.

not_tonight.title: Not tonight.
not_tonight.message: The fictional door reads tonight as not your night. Try again with one real change.
not_tonight.fix: Pick one strong element, latex, leather or a real costume, and commit to it fully.

go_home_change.title: Go home and change.
go_home_change.message: The fictional door closes fast. Too many street-clothes signals at once.
go_home_change.fix: Half-measures in street shoes are the fastest no. Start over with one committed look.

straight_in.title: The Regular
straight_in.reason: You dressed like you already know this room.

straight_in.title: The Committed
straight_in.reason: One strong look, worn with total confidence.

in_after_look.title: The Close Call
in_after_look.reason: Good instincts, one half-measure kept it from being easy.

in_after_look.title: The Right Idea
in_after_look.reason: The look was close. The door gave you the benefit of the doubt.

not_tonight.title: The Near Miss
not_tonight.reason: A few good calls were not enough to carry the whole night.

not_tonight.title: The Mixed Signal
not_tonight.reason: Part of the outfit said KitKat, the rest said tourist.

go_home_change.title: The Wrong Night
go_home_change.reason: Street clothes, street shoes, street energy. Not this door.

go_home_change.title: The Unprepared
go_home_change.reason: Zero commitment to the night's actual dress code.
